subject: [PATCH 13/16] selftests/mm: parameterize the mixed-source collapse case by source order

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c test to parameterize the mixed-source collapse case by source order. The test previously only tested one source order, but this change allows it to test multiple orders, including those that are not exercised deterministically due to the contpte threshold on certain architectures. A new option '-s' is introduced to specify the source order when combined with the existing '-o' target order. This change enables more comprehensive testing of the mixed-source collapse case and helps ensure the correctness of the khugepaged functionality.
